scripts.initialize: set -e; case "$(pnpm --version 2>/dev/null)" in 11.*) ;; *) sudo npm install -g --force pnpm@11.22.0 ;; esac; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; sudo apt-get update -qq; sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-venv libatomic1 unzip; python3 scripts/smoke.py --bootstrap-only --with-deps; if [ "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 ]; then pnpm exec agent-browser install --with-deps; else echo "agent-browser: no Chrome for Testing build for $(uname -m) Linux, set AGENT_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH to Playwright Chromium"; fi; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec "%s/node_modules/.bin/agent-browser" "$@"\n' "$PWD" > "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-browser"; chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/agent-browser"; G="$HOME/.local/share/gstack"; if [ ! -x "$G/bin/gstack-capy-install" ]; then rm -rf "$G"; git clone --single-branch --depth 1 https://github.com/garrytan/gstack.git "$G"; fi; "$G/bin/gstack-capy-install" --require claude,codex,patch
